summary: Seafire AB (publ) acquires and develops companies in Sweden, the Nordic region, rest of Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Components and Products segments. It markets and sells personal electric vehicles, such as electric bicycles, electric and walking scooters, and electric mopeds, as well as exercise equipment through online stores. The company also provides monitoring solutions for agricultural and industrial markets; develops customized industrial fans; supplies industrial paints; and provides CAD, CAM, CAE, and PDM/PLM solutions and services to create and develop products and manage product information. In addition, it engages in sheet metal production; fasteners and electrical material; supply of garden plants, as well as party nursery; processed clay and pumice for cultivation and construction; ground bricks; manufacture of brick walls; customized doors, windows, and entryways; supplies sandwich panels; designs, markets, and sells eyewear products, accessories, and tools for the optics industry; and develops and manufactures heating products. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
